list.title: Management reviews
list.subtitle: Top management checks at planned intervals that the management system still works. CoreFlow gathers the figures, turns decisions into tasks and keeps the signed report.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Meetings where decisions are taken: management reviews, the working environment committee, project and audit meetings. Each has an agenda, attendees, minutes and decisions with follow-up.
meetings.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, title or place

fields.title: Title
fields.changeNeeds: Changes needed to the management system

form.standardAgendaHint: Adds the agenda items the standards expect: previous actions, changes, performance, resources, risks, improvement and decisions.

form.description: Plan the review: what it covers, the period, and the meeting where top management goes through it.
form.frameworksAdopted: Only the standards the organisation follows are shown.
form.meetingIntro: The review is held in a meeting with top management. You can change all of this later.

standardAgenda.risks: Effectiveness of actions taken to address risks and opportunities

inputs.title: Inputs to the review
inputs.intro: One row per topic the standards require. Open a row, look at the figures, write what you see, and tick it as reviewed. If a topic does not apply, mark it not relevant and say why.
inputs.notRelevantMessage: Say briefly why this topic does not apply to the organisation in this period. The reason is shown in the report.
inputs.notesPlaceholder: What do the figures show? What should top management note?
inputs.savesOnLeave: Saves when you leave the field

previous_actions.title: Status of actions from previous reviews
previous_actions.hint: Were the decisions and actions from the last review carried out, and did they work?

context_changes.title: Changes in external and internal issues
context_changes.hint: Market, regulation, technology, organisation or ownership changes that affect the management system.

interested_parties.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
interested_parties.hint: New or changed requirements from customers, authorities, owners, staff or others.

customer_feedback.title: Customer satisfaction and feedback
customer_feedback.hint: Complaints, praise, surveys and other feedback from customers.

objectives.title: Extent to which objectives have been met
objectives.hint: Progress on quality, security or other objectives and their KPIs.

process_performance.title: Process performance and conformity of products and services
process_performance.hint: How the key processes performed and whether products and services met requirements.

nonconformities.title: Nonconformities and corrective actions
nonconformities.hint: Deviations raised and closed in the period, and how effective the corrective actions were.

monitoring_results.title: Monitoring and measurement results
monitoring_results.hint: Results of inspections, measurements and other monitoring.

audit_results.title: Audit results
audit_results.hint: Findings from internal and external audits in the period.

conformity_status.title: Conformity with the standards
conformity_status.hint: Readiness per standard: how many requirements are covered by evidence.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.hint: Security, safety or AI incidents reported in the period.

supplier_performance.title: Performance of external providers
supplier_performance.hint: How suppliers and other external providers performed.

compliance_obligations.title: Fulfilment of laws, regulations and other obligations
compliance_obligations.hint: Status of the laws, regulations and other obligations the organisation must meet.

environmental_aspects.title: Significant environmental aspects
environmental_aspects.hint: Changes in significant environmental aspects and environmental performance.

worker_consultation.title: Consultation and participation of workers
worker_consultation.hint: Results of consultation with workers and their representatives.

information_security.title: Information security performance
information_security.hint: Security incidents, risk treatment and feedback on information security.

ai_systems.title: AI systems and their impacts
ai_systems.hint: Changes to AI systems, impact assessments and AI-related concerns.

documented_information.title: Documented information
documented_information.hint: Status of controlled documents, including documents overdue for review.

resources.title: Adequacy of resources
resources.hint: Are people, skills, tools, infrastructure and budget sufficient?

risks_opportunities.title: Effectiveness of actions on risks and opportunities
risks_opportunities.hint: Did the planned risk treatments and opportunities deliver the expected effect?

improvement_opportunities.title: Opportunities for improvement
improvement_opportunities.hint: Ideas and suggestions for improving the management system.

criteria.heading: Is the management system working?
criteria.intro: ISO asks top management to conclude on each point below. The overall result is the weakest rating.
criteria.notDerived: Set when every point is rated.

suitability.label: Suitable
suitability.hint: Does the management system still fit the organisation, its context and its goals?

adequacy.label: Adequate
adequacy.hint: Does it cover what the standards and the organisation need, with enough resources?

effectiveness.label: Effective
effectiveness.hint: Does it deliver the intended results: objectives met, risks handled, fewer deviations?

strategic_alignment.label: Aligned with the strategy
strategic_alignment.hint: Does it support the strategic direction of the organisation (ISO 9001 9.3.1)?

clause.tooltip: Explain this clause in plain words
